configurations.//runtime: node, not `python -m http.server`: the Python one sends no cache headers, so Chrome served stale HTML and scripts for hours. server/static.js sends no-store, and refuses /.env and /data/.
configurations.//port: No fixed port. The site calls the API cross-origin and the API's CORS rule allows localhost on any port, so nothing here depends on 5501 — autoPort lets the harness pick a free one instead of colliding with a server already running.
configurations.name: sot-tracker-static
